title: AdapterProtocol
description: The schema root for the independently released framework adapter SDK.
$comment: Generated from crates/inferlab-protocol/src/wire.rs; do not edit.

AdapterError.description: A structured rejection an integration returns in an [`AdapterResponse::Error`].

AdapterErrorCode.description: Machine-readable failure category an adapter reports in an [`AdapterError`].

oneOf.description: The request was malformed or missing required fields.
The request's protocol version is not accepted.
A framework setting was unknown or invalid.
An unexpected internal failure occurred in the integration.
The requested operation is not supported by this integration.

AdapterRequest.description:
The one JSON request an integration reads from stdin, tagged by the
requested operation.

oneOf.description:
Plan a serve topology: declare roles, per-replica requirements, links,
and endpoint requirements from the requested shape.

Render final process invocations for a planned topology, given the
control plane's concrete process allocations.

AdapterResponse.description: The one JSON response an integration writes to stdout, tagged by outcome.

oneOf.description: The operation succeeded and carries its result.
The operation was rejected with a structured error.

AdapterResult.description:
The successful result of an [`AdapterRequest`], tagged by the operation it
answers.

oneOf.description: The planned topology from a `PlanServe` request.
The rendered process invocations from a `RenderServe` request.

AllocationLaunch.description: The machine-local launch channel selected by the control plane.

CaptureMechanism.description:
The workload-attached capture mechanism selected for a profiled serving
topology ([[RFC-0004:C-WORKLOAD-PROFILING]]).

oneOf.description:
InferLab wraps each target process with a managed Nsight Systems
collection.

The serving framework's internal profiler writes per-rank trace
artifacts under InferLab-directed storage.

CaptureTargetRequirement.description:
Marks a replica as a profiling capture target and carries its window
control ([[RFC-0004:C-WORKLOAD-PROFILING]]).

mechanism.description:
The capture mechanism this target declares; it must equal the
effective mechanism requested on the plan.

CaptureWindowControlEndpoint.description:
The logical workload endpoint exposing a capture target's window-control
actions.

oneOf.description: The entry process of the capture target's Engine replica.
The separately planned Gateway process.

CaptureWindowControlRequirement.description:
The logical workload endpoint and typed actions that open and close a
capture window.

CaptureWindowHttpActionSpec.description:
A capture-window HTTP action invoked against a logical serving endpoint.
The integration owns any framework-specific JSON body; the control plane
owns execution and evidence.

EndpointAssignment.description: A concrete host/port endpoint the control plane allocated for a process.

EndpointProtocol.description: The application protocol a workload endpoint speaks.

oneOf.description: HTTP.

EndpointRequirement.description:
The workload endpoint's protocol and named OpenAI paths, plus an optional
prefix-cache-reset action a Bench case can invoke between runs.

prefix_cache_conditioning.description:
A Gateway-backend conditioning fan-out action: the frontend routes one
conditioning request per prefill replica and attention data-parallel
rank ([[RFC-0004:C-BENCH-CACHE-STATE]]).

FrontendCoRendering.description: The fixed co-rendering requirement shared by compatible frontend plans.

FrontendComponents.description:
The only two frontend bindings protocol v9 accepts. Tuple representation
deliberately serializes as the closed ordered arrays `["gateway"]` and
`["gateway", "pd_router"]` rather than as an open component list.

FrontendGatewayComponent.description: The literal first member of every closed frontend component binding.

FrontendHandoff.description:
The currently demonstrated Gateway-to-P/D Router handoff is internal to
one fused frontend process.

FrontendPdRouterComponent.description: The literal second member of the fused P/D frontend component binding.

FrontendProcessRole.description: The one canonical process role available to a protocol-v9 frontend.

GatewayFrontendBinding.description: The stable schema branch for a Gateway-only frontend binding.

GatewayPdRouterFrontendBinding.description: The stable schema branch for a fused Gateway and P/D Router binding.

GatewayPlan.description:
The public frontend component plan returned independently from Engine and
P/D Router planning.

GatewayTarget.description: The target a Gateway forwards accepted public requests to.

oneOf.description: A routed-single Gateway targets the sole Engine role entry point.
A P/D Gateway hands requests to its co-rendered P/D Router component.

HttpActionSpec.description: An HTTP action invoked against a logical serving endpoint.

HttpMethod.description: The HTTP method of an action specification.

oneOf.description: HTTP POST.

IntegrationIdentity.description:
The integration's identity recorded on its results: adapter id, adapter
version, and the framework it lowers to.

KvTransferMechanism.description: The KV-transfer mechanism connecting prefill and decode.

oneOf.description: Mooncake KV-cache transfer.
NIXL KV-cache transfer.

LaunchFileDeclaration.description: One immutable text input a rendered process requires before it can launch.

Parallelism.description:
Framework-neutral component-aware parallelism ([[RFC-0003:C-SERVE-PARALLELISM]]).
Every component is optional so an operator can override one without
repeating the rest; omitted components are filled by the integration into a
complete effective shape.

outer.description: Outer deployment parallelism shared by attention and experts.

ParallelismAttention.description: Attention-block parallelism: tensor, data, and context degrees.

ParallelismExperts.description: MoE expert parallelism: tensor, data, expert, and dense-tensor degrees.

ParallelismOuter.description: Outer deployment parallelism: tensor and pipeline degrees.

PdRouterPlan.description:
The P/D orchestration component plan, kept separate even when the same
process and provider also realize Gateway.

PdRoutingPolicies.description: Independent policies for choosing prefill and decode targets.

PlanServeInput.description: The requested serve shape a `PlanServe` operation lowers into a topology.

profiling.description:
The effective capture mechanism when profiling is requested; absent
means no profiling ([[RFC-0004:C-WORKLOAD-PROFILING]]).

synthetic_acceptance.description:
The synthetic acceptance declaration when the serve declaration
carries one ([[RFC-0003:C-SERVE-SYNTHETIC-ACCEPTANCE]]).

PlanServeResult.description:
The lowered topology returned by a `PlanServe`: effective Engine roles,
whole-replica requirements, logical links, and separate optional Gateway
and P/D Router component plans.

synthetic_acceptance.description:
The resolved synthetic acceptance outcome; required in the accepted
plan whenever the request carried the declaration, and forbidden
otherwise ([[RFC-0003:C-SERVE-SYNTHETIC-ACCEPTANCE]]).

ProcessSpec.description: A launchable process: its argument vector and environment.

PromptCacheReadZeroRepresentation.description: How a backend with cache reporting enabled represents a zero-token cache read.

ProtocolVersion.description:
The shared protocol version used by framework integrations and release-owned
measurement clients. The only accepted value is `9` (serialized as the
string `"9"`); a mismatch is rejected before lowering.

oneOf.description: Protocol version 9.

ReadinessProbe.description: How the control plane decides a process is ready.

oneOf.description: Ready when an HTTP GET of `path` succeeds.

Ready when the public endpoint succeeds and its HTTP target registry
contains every control-plane-derived serving target.
Ready as soon as the process is alive.

RenderInputDeclaration.description:
One workspace-authored UTF-8 source file an integration declares during
planning for the control plane to supply during final rendering.

RenderServeInput.description:
The planned topology plus the control plane's concrete allocations that a
`RenderServe` operation turns into final process invocations.

profiling.description:
The effective capture mechanism when profiling is requested; absent
means no profiling ([[RFC-0004:C-WORKLOAD-PROFILING]]).

synthetic_acceptance.description:
The synthetic acceptance declaration when the serve declaration
carries one ([[RFC-0003:C-SERVE-SYNTHETIC-ACCEPTANCE]]).

RenderServeResult.description:
The final process invocations returned by a `RenderServe`, one per supplied
allocation.

RenderSource.description:
Which bounded implementation renders an accepted concrete frontend
allocation. This is a lowering boundary only; the control plane always
owns placement, lifecycle, cleanup, endpoints, and records.

RenderedServeProcess.description:
A rendered process bound to the model-rank or frontend allocation identity
it was produced for.

ServeModelInput.description: The logical model supplied during serving planning and rendering.

ServeProcessAllocation.description:
One concrete process allocation supplied to `RenderServe`. Model-rank and
process-only frontend identities are distinct so a frontend cannot acquire
model coordinates or a model locator by construction.

capture_storage.description:
The control-plane-assigned persistent trace directory; present
only when this rank belongs to an engine-trace capture target
([[RFC-0004:C-WORKLOAD-PROFILING]]).

ServeReplicaRequirement.description:
A whole-replica resource and readiness requirement the integration declares
without choosing placement, ranks, or concrete endpoints.

ServeRoleInput.description:
A requested serving role: its identity, kind, replica cardinality, and
declared (not-yet-completed) parallelism and settings.

ServeRoleKind.description: The logical role a replica plays in a serve topology.

oneOf.description: Aggregated serving role of a single topology.
Prefill role of a disaggregated topology.
Decode role of a disaggregated topology.

ServeRoleLink.description:
A directed link between serve roles the integration declares as part of the
topology.

oneOf.description: The source role routes requests to the target roles.
KV cache is transferred from source to target over `mechanism`.
The source discovers the target through a bootstrap port.
The source and target exchange out-of-band data over a side-channel port.

ServeRoleResult.description:
A role as the integration resolved it: preserved identity and cardinality
with the complete effective settings and parallelism.

public_endpoint.description:
The public endpoint contract for a direct `single` Engine. Gateway-
backed shapes leave this absent and carry the contract on Gateway.

oneOf.description: One aggregated serving role.
Disaggregated prefill and decode roles.

SettingValue.description:
A framework-specific server setting value carried as structured JSON data
(never a pre-rendered shell fragment) across the integration boundary.

anyOf.description: A JSON array of setting values.
A JSON object of named setting values.

SuppliedRenderInput.description:
The original declared path plus the exact UTF-8 contents and digest the
control plane supplies to an integration during final rendering.

sha256.description:
The SHA-256 digest of the curve file bytes, verified by the control
plane against the declaration.

text.description: The complete digest-verified curve file text.

thinking_mode.description:
The effective thinking mode: the declared mode, or `thinking_on` when
the declaration omits it and the model entry uses the thinking-mode
shape. Absent when the model entry is a flat list (no mode applies).

SyntheticAcceptanceInput.description:
The synthetic acceptance declaration carried to the selected integration
([[RFC-0003:C-SERVE-SYNTHETIC-ACCEPTANCE]]): exactly one of the explicit
acceptance length or the digest-verified golden curve with its lookup
coordinates. The draft count is not declared; the integration determines
it from the operator's speculative configuration ([[ADR-0043]]).

oneOf.description: The explicit form: the declared acceptance length, overlaid as-is.

The curve form: the digest-verified golden curve text with its digest
and lookup coordinates; the integration resolves the effective
acceptance length from it.

SyntheticAcceptanceOutcome.description:
The integration's resolved synthetic acceptance outcome, returned in the
`plan_serve` response whenever the request carried the declaration
([[RFC-0006:C-INTEGRATIONS]]).

acceptance_length.description: The effective acceptance length the integration resolved and overlaid.

draft_count.description:
The draft count the integration determined from the operator's
speculative configuration; present for the curve form, absent for the
explicit form.

TargetEndpointScheme.description: The application protocol used to identify serving targets in a registry.

oneOf.description: HTTP serving endpoint.
gRPC serving endpoint.
